newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.

text.p: All months of Tokyo corn futures closed lower on Wednesday, reflecting a weaker Chicago market overnight and long-liquidation by some powerful speculators, traders said.
Prices were 130 to 200 yen lower, with the benchmark November 1997 contract down 140 yen at 13,490 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 108,417 lots.
Traders said a weaker Chicago corn market overnight encouraged local investors to liquidate longs. "Some powerful investors were actively selling throughout the day," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.65-1/4 per bushel at 0850 GMT, unchanged from Tuesday's close.
The spot January contract of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $6.94-3/4 at 0850 GMT, against $6.95-1/2 at Tuesday's close.
